title: HealthCore Telemetry Event Schemas
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for every HealthCore telemetry event. Every event is composed from eventEnvelope with allOf + $ref. Must stay in sync with telemetry-plan.md.

eventEnvelope.description: The 8 fields every event carries (telemetry-plan.md, section 5). Only the content of properties changes between events.

eventId.description: UUID v4 generated where the event is created. Used to drop duplicates.

timestamp.description: When the event happened, ISO 8601 in UTC with a Z suffix.

sessionId.description: Browser or API session. Scheduled jobs use their job run ID.

userId.description: Pseudonymised staff ID or a service account (e.g. system:expiry-job). Never a name, email or patient identifier.

event_type.description: Event name in entity_action snake_case, past tense.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the event schema, starting at 1.0.0.

requestId.description: Correlation ID passed from frontend to API to logs (X-Request-Id header).

properties.description: Event-specific payload. Each event restricts it to its own allowlist.
